questions.question:
**Directions: In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

You hereby are requested (1)/ to ensure that any such link is (2)/ immediately removed from your Platforms. (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is **'1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Here, 'hereby' is an adverb that means as a result of this document or utterance. The adverb is used after the main verb to make it more meaningful. Thus, replace **hereby are **with **are hereby. **
 
• Hence, **option 1 **is the correct answer.

**So the correct sentence- *****You are hereby requested** to ensure that any such link is immediately removed from your Platforms. *

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

Kalpana is endowed ______ many great qualities.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

There are certain verbs which take fixed prepositions with them. Similarly, verb 'endow' takes **with **with it. It means to provide with a quality, ability, or asset; invest; confer. Hence, **option 3 **is the appropriate answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

Kashish is a very unhappy person, she ______ about almost everything.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Clearly, 'unhappy' gives the negative impact about Kashish's character, hence options 2, 3 & 4 does not match with his personality. Hence, **option 1 i.e. grumbles **is the most suitable word for the blank. It means to complain about something in an angry way.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

Fragile
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3) i.e. "Brittle".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fragile (नाजुक) **- Easily broken or damaged.

 
 
• Example: The vase was so fragile that it broke as soon as it was touched.
 
 
 
• **Brittle (भंगुर)** - Hard but liable to break or shatter easily.
 
 
• **Example**: The cookies were so brittle that they crumbled at the slightest touch.
 
 
 
• Brittle shares a close meaning with fragile as both imply something that can easily break or be damaged. Therefore, brittle is the term that best expresses the meaning of fragile.

Therefore, the correct answer is** "Brittle".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tough (कठिन) - Strong enough to withstand adverse conditions or rough handling.
 
 
• Example: Leather is a tough material that can last for years.
 
 
 
• Sturdy (मजबूत) - Strongly and solidly built.
 
 
• Example: The sturdy table can support a lot of weight without breaking.
 
 
 
• Hairy (बालों वाला) - Having a lot of hair.
 
 
• Example: The dog was so hairy that grooming it took hours.

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given,select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

Management is a set of

P: technology running smoothly

Q: system of people and

R: processes that can keep a complicated
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Now, a sentence does not end with conjunction. Thus, option 4 is incorrect. Also, 'a complicated' shows it is used as adjective, hence a noun should also be followed. Thus, a sentence does not end with an adjective like this. So, options 2 & 3 are incorrect. Hence, **option 1 i.e. RQP **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given,select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

India is a country

P: which respects spiritualism 

Q: much more 

R: than materialism
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Clearly, a sentence does not end with determiner 'more'. Hence, option 1 is eliminated. Now, 'country' is not considered as human, so relative pronoun 'which' is used for things or animals. And, relative pronoun is used directly with the noun/pronoun. Thus, the sequence should start with P. Hence, **option 3 i.e. PQR **is the appropriate answer.

questions.question: of Internet are ___________ for lay
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

The above given passage is based upon advantages of using Internet, that how it helps people learning things without actually going to that place. 

Here, the context explains that benefits of internet. Hence, options 1 & 2 are out of context. Now, the meaning of 'uncomprehending' is not easily understood. Since, the passage describes benefits of using Internet so they must be understood as well. Hence, **option 4 i.e. unthinkable **is an appropriate answer. This is because, we cannot even think what can be its benefits.

questions.question: The most __________, the cheapest,
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Since the context explains the benefits of Internet. Hence, it is clearly not a limited or restricted way that people can afford. Hence, options 3 & 4 are incorrect. The word 'extensive' means large in amount or scale. Clearly, we can't say it is the most unthinkable way, because this cannot be judged. Thus, **option 2 i.e. extensive **is the appropriate answer. Also, we know Internet works at global level, hence it connects people at large.
